occurrences.text: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters’ vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
